questions: Optional item 4 (`--undo` by record) needs your decision on the record contract. The record is shared with the Claude settings step and carries no scope or step tag. Telling a Pi file in a changed `PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR` or `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` location from a Claude settings file or another project's file needs a tag. I did not change the persistent record schema, so `--undo` still locates files from the current environment. The docs say to run `--undo` with the old environment values.
notes:
- Item 1 is subsumed by the global skip. Any key set in the global file is never written at project scope, so a default left out there cannot hide a different global value. A comment on `resolveTarget` says so.
- A global file that is not a JSON object stops that project-scope write with a `!` line (the global values are unknown). Doctor reports this and a symlinked `.pi` as `~` hints.
- The symlink guard checks every path part from `.pi` down to the file, so a symlinked `providers/` folder is refused too. User scope still follows links, and a test covers that.
- The existing test "project scope backs out the project's files only" now runs project setup before user setup. Otherwise the global skip leaves nothing in the project files, and its intent is unchanged.
- A record failure after the file write is now a `!` line naming that file, saying `--undo` will not remove its keys. I chose this over record-before-write because a stale record entry could later remove a user's own matching value.
